people.imagined: The granary clerk's daughter with mud to her elbows, digging a plot of her own beside the Heir's Garden, her city accent in her stubborn jaw.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a freshly dug plot in the pale light of early evening, she has planted a spade in the earth and lifts her chin stubbornly at the viewer. Face, most important: thick wet mud to both elbows on bare forearms held in front of her, and a firm lifted chin. A broad, short-statured, round-faced girl of nineteen; tanned skin with a dirt streak on the cheek; determined dark eyes; thick brows; a snub nose; a tight mouth; round freckled cheeks and a slightly prominent chin under a stubborn upper lip. Hair: black, in a bun held with a plain green silk ribbon and one small jade pin. Body: short, broad, strong. Clothing: the simplest graceful outer-gate dress of the Thúy Vi sect: a green-grey silk robe with two crossed collars, its wide sleeves pushed up to the shoulder and dark with mud, a pale grey silk sash wound twice round her waist, a faint silver herb-leaf embroidered on the hem, the lower folds damp and earth-stained. Hands: both on the spade handle. Power: a faint brown-gold haze of earth qi curls up from the freshly turned soil round her hands. Background: a dark hillside of drifting mist, the square of dark earth beside a larger garden, green sprouts glowing faintly, a stake at each corner. Light: soft silver spirit-light from the upper left with a pale green rim along her cheek and shoulder. Expression: a stubborn lifted chin with a set mouth and fierce, determined eyes, a smear of mud on her cheek.

people.imagined: The handsome outer disciple who learns everyone's name on the first day, smiling easily, with a pine-palace man's eye behind the smile.
people.subject: The moment: in the blue glow of a lantern-lit courtyard he leans in with a warm easy smile, as if about to greet the viewer by name. Face, most important: a very handsome, open face with a bright easy smile and warm amber eyes that hold the viewer's gaze a beat too long. Age twenty-four; smooth fair skin; light amber-brown eyes with long lashes; arched fine brows; a straight nose; white even teeth and a small dimple in the left cheek. Hair: black, in a tidy topknot bound with a green silk cord and a slim jade hairpin. Body: tall, easy, well-proportioned. Clothing: outer-disciple dress of the Thúy Vi sect worn better than anyone's: a green-grey silk robe with two crossed collars, a pine-green silk lining flashing at the wide cuffs, a pale grey silk sash tied in a neat flat knot with a small jade bead hanging from it, fine silver herb embroidery on the cuff borders. Hands: one hand extended in greeting. Power: a faint green shimmer of wood qi, a few motes drifting about his sleeve. Background: a dark, softly blurred courtyard with whitewashed walls, students in small groups, a persimmon tree glowing with orange fruit under a misty night sky. Light: gentle moonlight from the upper left with a pale green rim light on his hair. Expression: a warm, easy smile with friendly eyes that take the viewer in quickly, a watchful gleam behind the charm.

people.imagined: The warden's son would rather fish than fight and has not told his father; a fish scale sticks to his sleeve.
people.subject: The moment: seated at the end of a pier in the silver light of an evening river mist, he glances sideways at the viewer with a small guilty grin. Face, most important: a single large silvery fish scale glinting on his sleeve, and a bamboo fishing rod held loosely in both hands. A mild, sun-browned, easygoing face of twenty-two; soft dark eyes; light brows; a snub nose slightly peeling from sun; a lazy half-smile; a smear of river mud on one cheek; eyes crinkled with easy guilt, a flush at the ears. Hair: black, tousled, tied with a bit of blue silk cord. Body: lanky, relaxed, slouching. Clothing: a graceful green-grey silk outer-disciple robe with two crossed collars and wide sleeves, the hem damp from the water, a loose sash of Cold Ford blue silk worn untied, a faint silver wave embroidered along the border; a small wicker creel slung at his shoulder with a silvery fish tail peeping out, a fine fishing line wrapped round his wrist. Power: a faint blue water shimmer rises from the ripples at his feet. Background: dark water of a river mouth, moored boats, reed-beds swaying, drifting mist and a few motes of light. Light: cool moonlight from the upper left, a soft glow on the water, pale blue rim light on his cheek. Expression: a small guilty grin with a sideways glance, the face loose and content.

people.imagined: On the oyster-bed pier, she stares at the sky where the sea eagles wheel, jaw set, her sister's loss in her eyes. She has not yet been allowed to kill one.
people.subject: The moment: on a plank pier above the oyster beds in a grey, glimmering dusk she stares upward at a hunting sea eagle, jaw clenched, one hand on a barbed spear; her sister's loss is in her eyes, and she has not yet been allowed to kill one. Face, most important: a long white scar from an eagle's talon, three fine parallel lines running along her left jaw from ear to chin, clear against tanned skin. A hard, handsome, narrow face of thirty-four with deep-set dark eyes, straight heavy brows, a sharp nose and a thin tight mouth, the lips chapped by salt wind. Hair: black, chin-length, straight, wind-blown, held by a single silver pin. Body: lean, wiry, tense. Clothing: a green-grey silk outer-disciple robe with crossed collars, sleeves rolled and stiff with salt at the cuffs, a blue-green port-house silk sash knotted twice with a small jade toggle, a fitted dark sea-silk cape drawn over her shoulders and fastened at the throat with a carved bone clasp, fine silver wave embroidery on the border. Hands and objects: a barbed oyster-bed spear held upright. Power: a thin blue-green water haze clings to the spear's barbs. Background: grey sea in drifting mist, wet black posts marching out into silver shallows, two dark birds wheeling in a pale glowing sky. Light: cold silvery sky-light from the upper left with a faint blue rim. Expression: a clenched jaw and a cold, burning stare turned skyward, the mouth hard and thin.

people.imagined: The Cliff Hall's cook of seventy years holds his ladle like a sceptre over the cauldron, deciding the day's salt by his mood.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a great iron cauldron in a steam-filled hall, he lifts a long wooden ladle like a sceptre and regards the viewer with grand self-importance. Face, most important: a big wooden ladle held upright in front of him like a royal sceptre, and a round, red-cheeked, bushy-browed face. Age appearing about fifty-eight; ruddy skin broken with tiny red veins; small bright black eyes; thick grey brows tilted upward like a wizard's; a bulbous shiny nose; a wide pursed mouth. Hair: thin white, under a neat pale cloth cap pushed back. Body: short, round-bellied, plump hands. Clothing: a servant's dress kept clean and graceful, as the Cliff Hall's cook is proud of it: a plain brown-grey silk-hemp robe with two crossed collars and sleeves rolled to the elbow, a pale green silk sash with a thin silver herb border, a clean white cloth tied at the neck, a ring of keys and a small jade charm at his belt; the ladle's long handle is dark with years of use. Hands: the ladle in one fist, the other holding a pinch of salt aloft. Power: none, only a faint grey-gold glow in the rising steam. Background: a huge black iron cauldron on a brick hearth, strings of dried peppers and hanging pots, salt jars in the corner, all softened by glowing mist. Light: warm golden steam-light from the lower left with a soft pale rim. Expression: a grand, self-important look with lifted chin and heavy lids, a pompous half-smile.

people.imagined: The herd boy of the outer gate, boots caked in dung, sitting beside his old grandfather's feet for his last spring.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on a log with his boots stuck out in front, he grins and tips his head toward an unseen old man beside him, in the glow of a late spring evening. Face, most important: heavy boots thickly caked with dried dung stretched out in the foreground, and a sunburnt cheerful face. A wide, easy face of eighteen; brown skin; bright brown eyes; messy dark brows; a flat nose peeling and freckled; big ears; a loose grin with a dimple on one cheek. Hair: black, shaggy and sun-streaked, tied with a green silk ribbon. Body: stocky, relaxed, slouched. Clothing: a herd boy's dress kept simple but graceful: a green-grey silk outer-gate robe with two crossed collars, the wide hem spattered with mud and grass, a grey silk sash tied in a lazy loop, a short sleeveless over-vest of dark sage silk, scuffed and sweat-dark. Hands: a bamboo switch across his knees. Power: a faint green-gold dust of wood qi drifts in the low light. Background: a misty pasture rolling to a line of willows, a few cattle grazing as soft shapes, motes of golden dust hanging in the air. Light: warm amber spirit-light from the upper left with a soft green rim on his hair. Expression: a wide, lazy grin with a loose jaw and warm eyes turned toward the old man.

people.imagined: A rope-maker's son lifts his chin hopefully at an elder who passes, rope-braid in hand, wanting the inner gate.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a drying frame under glowing night mist, he lifts his chin with a hopeful, over-eager look at a passing elder. Face, most important: a chin lifted very high, hopeful and rigid, and a rope of braided herb-line looped round one forearm. A thin, eager face of twenty-one; sallow skin; bright anxious eyes; thin brows raised so high they wrinkle his forehead; a long nose; a tight eager smile; jaw shaved close; tiny beads of sweat at the temple. Hair: black, in a neat knot with a green silk cord and a plain jade pin. Body: thin, tense, very straight. Clothing: a flawless outer-gate robe of green-grey silk with two crossed collars and wide sleeves tied back with cord, ironed flat, a pale grey silk sash tied in an exact knot with ends of equal length, silver herb embroidery on the border, a small petition-box on a cord at his chest, callus-split fingers gripping the loop. Hands: both holding a loop of braided drying-line. Power: none, only a faint green hint on the herbs. Background: long lines of herbs hung drying from bamboo frames in rows, green-grey leaves and pale roots swaying in drifting mist, a tiled roof above. Light: soft silver moonlight from the upper left with a pale green rim. Expression: a hopeful, over-eager look with raised brows and a smile a little too bright to be natural.

people.imagined: She lacquers red pill boxes in a quiet shed, her hands stained red to the wrist and never itching.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a lacquering bench in a quiet shed, she holds up a freshly lacquered red box, patient and pleased. Face, most important: both hands stained deep lacquer-red up to the wrist, and a glossy scarlet pill box held up between them. A soft, broad, quiet face of twenty-six; light brown skin; calm dark eyes with lowered lids; thin soft brows; a small nose; a modest smile; a tiny red lacquer speck near her eye. Hair: black, in a low plait tied with a red silk ribbon and a small silver pin. Body: small, steady. Clothing: a graceful green-grey silk robe of the outer gate with two crossed collars, wide sleeves tied up with silk string over the elbows, a dark glossy over-apron of waxed silk spotted red and black, a neat grey silk sash, silver herb embroidery faint on the cuffs; the stained hands are the same warm red as the boxes. Hands: the red-stained hands holding the lacquered box. Power: a faint warm green shimmer about the box. Background: shelves with rows of drying red boxes glowing softly like lanterns, a small brazier, a shaft of pale light from a high window in drifting haze. Light: soft warm spirit-light from the upper left with a gentle green rim. Expression: quiet satisfaction, eyes cast down on her work.

people.imagined: The fire-tender, charcoal smell in every season, hesitates at the furnace door, having told what he saw for a place at the second cauldron.
people.subject: The moment: crouching at a furnace mouth with a poker, he glances back over his shoulder with a guarded, uneasy look, having told what he saw for a place at the second cauldron. Face, most important: soot-darkened skin with a charcoal-black smear across his nose, and a long iron poker held up. A lean, angular, honest-looking face of twenty-eight, tanned, with wary dark eyes whose whites are red from smoke, thick straight brows singed short, a long nose and a tight mouth; the soot is deepest in the creases by the eyes and mouth. Hair: black and short, dusted grey with ash. Body: wiry and hunched. Clothing: the inner-gate dress of the Thúy Vi sect in a furnace-keeper's version: a green-grey silk robe with two crossed collars and a pale green silk collar edge, sleeves bound with cord at the elbow, a dark scorch-edged over-apron of fireproof silk, a damp pale cloth round his neck, a dark green cord at the waist, ash-blackened boots. Hands and objects: a long iron poker, its end glowing dull orange. Power: green furnace-fire sparks and motes of pale green qi drift upward from the poker. Background: the furnace door gaping with green flame, a row of cauldrons in silhouette, drifting sparks. Light: eerie green furnace glow from the lower left with a soft cool rim above. Expression: uneasy and cautious, a guarded, sidelong look with the smell of charcoal in every season.

people.imagined: A poria-digger's girl, newly a second disciple, smiling openly, unaware that a rival watches her.
people.subject: The moment: in a sunlit old pine forest she holds up a pale knobbly poria root in both hands with a bright open smile, newly a second disciple and unaware that a rival watches her. Face, most important: a small pale crescent scar on the point of her chin, and a large pale tuber held up in both hands. A round, fresh, friendly face of twenty-three, warm brown, with flushed round cheeks, bright sparkling hazel eyes, thick soft brows, a small nose and a wide smile. Hair: brown, in a long braid tied with a green silk ribbon and a tiny jade bead. Body: sturdy and bouncy. Clothing: the inner-gate dress of the Thúy Vi sect: a green-grey silk robe with two crossed collars, a pale green silk collar spotted with soil, a dark green cord at the waist, a short sleeveless herb-digger's over-vest of brown silk with a small silver trowel in its pocket, wide sleeves with mud-crusted cuffs, silver herb embroidery along the border. Hands and objects: the root held high, her fingers earthy to the knuckle and nails dark with soil. Power: a soft green sparkle of wood qi gathers around the root. Background: old pines sloping upward through glowing mist, golden fallen needles, a dug hole and a small pile of earth nearby, shafts of light between the trunks. Light: warm gold morning spirit-light from the upper left, a bright spot on the pale root. Expression: an open, delighted smile with wide, bright eyes and nothing held back.

people.imagined: A kelp-gatherer's son, a runner who gives his rations away, belt wrapped twice round a thin waist, holding out his last rice cake.
people.subject: The moment: halting mid-run on a sea-wall road, he holds out a rice cake to the viewer with a generous grin, the last of his rations. Face, most important: a plain rope belt wrapped twice round an extremely thin waist and cinched tight, and a pale rice cake offered in one hand. A thin, bright, honest face of thirty, brown skin stretched over high cheekbones, warm dark eyes in deep hollows, thick brows, a wide nose, chapped lips and a generous grin. Hair: black, tied with a green silk cord, wind-tousled. Body: very thin, tall and wiry. Clothing: a runner's version of outer-disciple dress: a green-grey silk robe with two crossed collars cut short for running, its light sleeves fluttering, bunching at the rope belt, a blue port-house silk sash, a flat, nearly empty messenger's pouch at the hip, silver wave embroidery on the border, scuffed sandals. Hands and objects: the rice cake, still warm and wrapped in a corner of green leaf. Power: a faint blue-green water mist trails behind him as he runs. Background: a harbour road along a sea wall in glowing haze, gulls wheeling over drying nets, stacked kelp racks to one side. Light: bright silvery sea-light from the upper left, a soft glow on his thin cheeks. Expression: generous and gregarious, an open, giving grin that does not notice its own hunger.

people.imagined: A new outer disciple who cannot sit still through a lesson, sticky resin on her fingers, fidgeting as her jar sits on a shelf.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a lesson she fidgets, picking at her sticky fingers and glancing at the door, while her jar sits on a shelf. Face, most important: golden amber resin sticky on her fingertips, strings of it stretching between finger and thumb, and a restless bright face. A pert, round face of nineteen, olive skin, rosy cheeks, sparkling dark eyes that dart to the door, quick arched brows, a snub nose, a small smear of resin glinting on the chin and a restless half-smile. Hair: black, in two short buns tied with green silk ribbons, a pine needle stuck in one. Body: small and wriggling. Clothing: new outer-disciple dress of the Thúy Vi sect: a green-grey silk robe with two crossed collars and long wide sleeves that hang over her fingers and stick at the cuffs with resin, a pale grey silk sash half untied, silver herb-leaf embroidery on the borders, a tiny jade jar on a cord at her neck. Hands and objects: sticky amber threads between her fingers. Power: a faint pale green tint glows in the resin, a few motes rising from it. Background: a lesson hall with rows of cushions, the blurred figure of an old teacher at the front, soft light slanting through a wooden lattice in drifting incense mist. Light: soft silver spirit-light from the upper left, gold on the resin. Expression: bored and fickle, a restless, bright impatience that cannot wait for the lesson to end.

people.imagined: A stonecutter's son has made peace with the outer gate; he lays terrace walls, his fingertips cut flat by stone.
people.subject: The moment: kneeling at a half-built terrace wall at dusk, he sets a stone with calm certainty and looks up with a peaceable face. Face, most important: fingertips worn flat and blunt by stone, resting on a pale stone block, and a heavy sunburnt face. A broad, square, quiet face of thirty-two; brown skin; patient dark eyes; thick brows dusted with stone; a flat nose; a closed mouth; scarred knuckles; the calm of a man who has stopped arguing with the world. Hair: black, cropped short, grey with stone dust. Body: heavy, broad, solid. Clothing: a mason's outer-gate dress, plain but graceful: a green-grey silk robe with two crossed collars, sleeves rolled above thick forearms, a pale grey silk sash stiff with lime, protective knee-pads of dark silk-wadding tied over the dusty knees, a plumb-line with a small jade weight hanging from his belt, faint silver herb embroidery on the hem. Hands: both on a stone. Power: a faint brown-gold earth haze rises from the stone beneath his hands. Background: a terraced wall of fitted grey stone stepping up a dim hillside, green rice-shoots glowing on the upper level, tools laid neatly by the wall, drifting mist. Light: soft silver-gold spirit-light from the upper left with a faint rim along his shoulder. Expression: a peaceful, steady face with calm eyes and a stubborn, quiet set to the mouth.

people.imagined: A raftsman on a log raft in autumn, bow-legged balanced stance as it shoots the rapids with spirit wood.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a raft of logs in autumn as it shoots the rapids with spirit wood, legs wide apart and bowed, steering with a long pole. Face, most important: a deeply bow-legged wide stance on a moving raft of logs, and a long steering pole gripped in both hands. A tanned, lined, cheerful face of twenty-nine, ruddy brown and windburned, with sharp light brown eyes crinkled from spray, thick brows with drops hanging on them, a hooked nose and a broad grin. Hair: black, tied with a cord, wet with spray. Body: short, strong, broad-chested. Clothing: a raftsman's dress, graceful but practical: a green-grey silk robe with two crossed collars cut short at the knee and soaked, a short dark sage silk vest, a blue river silk sash tied tight, silver wave embroidery dark with water, bare calves scratched from bark, hobnailed boots gripping the logs. Hands: the long wooden pole, knuckles white. Power: a faint blue-green spray of water qi lifts around him, bright motes in the droplets. Background: a rushing river between steep forested banks, more logs bobbing in the froth, mist rising from the rapids. Light: bright silvery spirit-light from the upper left glittering on the spray, small rainbows round his head. Expression: brave and honest, gregarious, a wide, exhilarated grin that is perfectly at home on a moving floor.

people.imagined: The newest outer disciple, seventeen, checks her life tree before breakfast; a leaf from it is pinned in her braid.
people.subject: The moment: standing beside a thin sapling at dawn, one hand lightly holding its top, she checks her life tree anxiously before breakfast. Face, most important: a small bright green leaf from her life tree pinned in a thin braid, and a hand lightly holding the sapling's top. A thin, young, trusting face of seventeen, light brown, with wide worried brown eyes, thin brows, a small nose, a hopeful mouth with the upper lip trembling very slightly, and cheeks pink from the early cold. Hair: black, in a thin plait over one shoulder, tied with a green silk thread. Body: slight and slim. Clothing: the newest outer disciple's dress of the Thúy Vi sect, simple and new: a green-grey silk robe with two crossed collars, slightly stiff, sleeves a thumb too long, a grey silk sash neatly tied, a few silver herb-leaves embroidered on the border, a small silk bag of fertiliser at her belt. Hands and objects: one hand on the tiny tree. Power: a faint pale green glow gathers around the sapling's leaves, a few motes rising. Background: a hillside of saplings each tied with a coloured cord, cold white mist at their feet, a pink streak of dawn glowing above. Light: soft pink and pearl dawn spirit-light from the upper left with a gentle green rim. Expression: trusting and diligent, anxious, the wide, hopeful look of a girl who is afraid her tree has not grown.

people.imagined: A field worker with a broad nose burnt red by spring sun, writing her cousin's rows in a ledger as her own, smiling.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a wheat field in bright spring light, wiping her brow with a sleeve, smiling affably while a brush is tucked behind her ear; she is writing her cousin's rows in her own ledger. Face, most important: a broad nose burnt bright red by the sun, peeling a little, in a round brown face. She is twenty-five, with bright quick eyes, thick sun-bleached brows, a wide smile and a bead of sweat running down her temple; the brush behind her ear is dark at the tip with fresh ink. Hair: black, in a bun under a wide straw hat stained at the band, with a green silk ribbon. Body: sturdy and broad-shouldered. Clothing: outer-gate dress of the Thúy Vi sect: a green-grey silk robe with two crossed collars, sleeves rolled to the shoulder over muscular tanned forearms, a damp grey silk sash, a small cord-bound ledger tucked into her belt, faint silver herb embroidery on the hem. Hands: one hand wipes her forehead, the other holds a hoe. Power: a faint brown-green tint of earth and wood qi shimmers over the crop. Background: a green wheat field stretching in golden haze, a row of scarecrows at the edge, pale butterflies hovering over the stalks like motes of light. Light: bright warm spirit-light from the upper left, gold on the peeling red nose and the bead of sweat. Expression: friendly and ambitious, an affable, deceitful smile that gives nothing away about the ledger.

people.imagined: The copyist copies a forbidden recipe into his own book first; his fingertips are dyed grey from old paper.
people.subject: The moment: bent over a desk in the library at night, he glances up furtively, covering a second small book with his sleeve; he copies a forbidden recipe into his own book first. Face, most important: fingertips stained slate-grey from old paper, spread on the page, and a second small book half hidden under his sleeve. A pale, narrow, shut face of thirty-one, with hooded dark eyes, thin neat brows, a thin nose, a closed mouth, a vertical line between the brows, and the grey of old paper staining the lower lip. Hair: black, tied in a plain knot with a dark wooden pin and a green silk cord. Body: slim and stooped. Clothing: the inner-gate dress of the Thúy Vi sect: a green-grey silk robe with two crossed collars, a crisp pale green silk collar, ink-grey cuffs, sleeves wide enough to hide a book, a dark green cord at the waist with a small jade lamp-wick trimmer hanging from it, thin silver herb embroidery along the border. Hands and objects: grey fingertips on an old yellowed book. Power: a faint pale green glow lies over the page, a few motes lifting from the ink. Background: shelves crowded with old books in yellowed covers, a lamp in a niche casting a small circle of light, dark corners full of drifting dust and mist. Light: dim golden lamp-light from the lower left with a thin silver-green rim, the rest in shadow. Expression: diligent and reclusive, a deceitful stillness, the shut, careful face of a man hiding something under his sleeve.

people.imagined: A beekeeper's daughter, bee-sting welts like beads along her neck, stands among her spirit bees, keeping the best comb back.
people.subject: The moment: standing among humming hives in a golden meadow, she lifts a golden honeycomb and smiles slyly, keeping the best comb back. Face, most important: a row of small healed round sting welts along her neck like a string of beads, and bees crawling on her bare forearm. A round, rosy, shrewd face of twenty-seven; fair skin; clever light brown eyes narrowed with cunning; thin brows; a small nose; a slow sly smile; plump flushed cheeks, the welts pale pink in a neat row. Hair: light brown, in a thick braid under a straw hat pushed back with a fine net veil of silk gauze lifted onto the brim. Body: stout, steady. Clothing: a beekeeper's dress of the Thúy Vi sect, graceful but honey-stained: a green-grey silk robe with two crossed collars, sleeves rolled to the elbow over forearms speckled with old stings, a short over-apron of heavy dark silk sticky with honey, the grey outer-gate silk sash tied low, silver herb embroidery on the border. Hands: a dripping golden comb. Power: a faint golden shimmer of spirit bees' qi, bees threading the air as streaks of light. Background: wooden hives in a sunlit meadow of flowers dissolving into glowing mist, a pail of honeycomb at her feet. Light: warm gold spirit-light from the upper left, a bright rim on her hat and braid. Expression: a sly, pleased smile with sidelong eyes and a lifted chin, keeping something back.

people.imagined: The crow-keeper, a feather stuck in his hair on the same side always, with crows on the fence; he has invented a death for amusement.
people.subject: The moment: with crows perched on a fence at his shoulder he leans toward the viewer to murmur a secret, eyes bright; he has invented a death for amusement. Face, most important: a black crow feather stuck upright in his hair above the left ear, and a black crow perched on his shoulder. A narrow, pale, clever face of twenty-four, with dark, sharp, restless eyes like a crow's, thick black brows, narrow cheeks, a thin nose, and a sly crooked smile whose lips twitch as if sharing a joke with the birds. Hair: black and untidy, standing up in tufts, tied loosely with a dark green silk cord. Body: thin and loose. Clothing: outer-gate dress of the Thúy Vi sect: a green-grey silk robe with two crossed collars, a grey silk sash hung with a pouch of grain and a small jade bead, a second black feather tucked in the collar, a thick dark silk pad on the shoulder scratched by claws where the crow sits, faint silver herb embroidery on the cuffs. Hands: a handful of grain held out. Power: a faint dark-green haze of wood qi swirls round the crows, motes of dim light on the feathers. Background: a weathered fence with three black crows perched and a fourth landing, a bare tree, a pale misty sky. Light: cool moonlight from the upper left, picking out the blue sheen of the feathers, a thin silver rim. Expression: sly and fickle, reclusive, the delighted, conspiratorial look of someone who has just told a lie to a bird.

people.imagined: She reads the scriptures aloud to the field workers at night, a pressed red leaf in her cap band, calm and devout.
people.subject: The moment: sitting under a lantern at night she reads aloud from a scroll to field workers, her voice quiet, looking up gently. Face, most important: a flat pressed red maple leaf tucked into the band of her cap, bright crimson against the green-grey. A mild, quiet, oval face of twenty-eight, pale, with soft dark eyes tired from reading by lamplight, thin brows, a small nose, and a gentle mouth whose shape shows the soft cadence of her voice. Hair: black, in a bun under a neat silk cap tied under the chin. Body: slender and still. Clothing: outer-gate dress of the Thúy Vi sect: a green-grey silk robe with two crossed collars and narrow sleeves tied back, a grey silk sash tied flat, a thin silver herb border at the hem, the pressed maple leaf vivid against the cap band. Hands and objects: a bamboo scroll, bound with a cord, held open, its strips blank to the eye. Power: a faint green-blue hint of qi lifts from the scroll like breath on a cold night. Background: vague figures of tired field workers seated on mats, listening, a glowing lantern on a post, fields stretching away into dark mist. Light: warm lantern light from the lower left, gold on the pale cheek, a soft silver rim from above. Expression: humble and patient, devout, a calm, reading look that does not hurry anyone to understand.

people.imagined: The woodcutter's son sings quietly in the fields, humming even in his sleep, mouth half open.
people.subject: The moment: leaning on a hoe in a field of young shoots, humming softly with eyes half closed, in a daze of afternoon contentment. Face, most important: a mouth slightly open in a hum, the throat visibly moving, and a dreamy face. A wide, soft, easy face of thirty-three, brown, with half-lidded brown eyes, thin brows, a blunt nose, a relaxed mouth and a slack, happy jaw; a woodcutter's callus shows on his palm. Hair: black, tied loosely with straw and a green silk thread, under a straw hat pushed back. Body: tall and loose, in a contented slouch with the weight on one hip. Clothing: outer-gate dress of the Thúy Vi sect: a green-grey silk robe with two crossed collars loosely belted, wide sleeves, the hem damp, a grey silk sash knotted at the side, faint silver herb embroidery on the border. Hands: both resting on a hoe handle. Power: a faint green shimmer of wood qi hangs in the air above the shoots, a few motes drifting with his hum. Background: young green shoots glowing in afternoon haze, a faint line of hills beyond, a few swallows dipping over the crop. Light: warm gold spirit-light from the upper left, picking out the fine hairs on his forearms and leaving the face in warm green shade under the hat brim. Expression: content and lazy, gregarious, the loose, humming serenity of a man who hums even in his sleep.

people.imagined: A water-carrier with a limp from the spring's steps, two jars on a pole, compassionate and calm.
people.subject: The moment: on a stone stair she steadies a yoke pole with two water pails, her weight shifted onto her good leg, carrying water from the spring with a calm face. Face, most important: a visible limp, the body tipped off-centre under the yoke, the left foot turned slightly inward, and two wooden water pails hanging from the pole. A gentle, pale, serene face of twenty-one, with clear calm eyes, level brows, a straight nose, a quiet smile and a trace of strain at the mouth with each step. Hair: black, in a long braid tied with a blue silk ribbon. Body: slim and tilted. Clothing: outer-gate dress of the Thúy Vi sect: a green-grey silk robe with two crossed collars, the hem darkened by splashes, a pale blue Healing House silk sash tied firmly, a folded silk pad cushioning her shoulder under the yoke, silver herb and wave embroidery on the borders. Hands: both holding the yoke ropes. Power: a faint blue water shimmer glows around the pails, droplets rising as motes of light. Background: mossy stone steps climbing to a spring bubbling from a rock, ferns hanging over the water, a cool green mist filtering through leaves. Light: soft cool moonlight from the upper left with a pale blue rim. Expression: compassionate and devout, calm, a quiet, unhurried patience in a face that has long since stopped minding the stair.

people.imagined: A fisher girl whose bare feet stand firm in every weather, promised the first voyage south, impatient at the quay.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a quay edge at the hour of a pearl-grey sunrise, looking out to sea with arms folded, impatient for the first voyage south. Face, most important: bare feet planted firmly on wet planks, shown at the bottom of the frame, and a windblown determined face. A strong, tanned, freckled face of twenty-four; bright sea-grey eyes; thick brows; a short nose; a firm mouth; wind-reddened cheeks and eyes narrowed against the glare. Hair: dark brown, in a thick sun-streaked braid, wind-whipped, a silver pin at the crown. Body: strong, compact, shoulders squared. Clothing: inner-gate dress of the Thúy Vi sect: a green-grey silk robe cut short for work with two crossed collars and sleeves rolled, a pale green silk collar, a tight blue silk sash with a dark green cord, a coil of rope hanging from her belt, silver wave embroidery on the border; her wide brown feet bare on the wet plank. Hands: arms crossed. Power: a faint blue water sparkle gathers about her bare feet, wind-blown motes of light. Background: a harbour of ships, nets and barrels dissolving into glowing mist, a dark blue sea shot with white caps. Light: bright wind-swept pearl light from the upper left, glinting on wet planks and the whites of her eyes. Expression: a squinting, impatient stare out to sea with a set jaw and a tight, eager mouth.

people.imagined: The weather-reader, an earlobe pierced twice for luck, wets a finger and holds it up to the wind.
people.subject: The moment: on a ship's deck he holds up a wet finger to the wind, eyes narrowed, calm, reading the weather. Face, most important: one earlobe pierced twice with two small gold rings, glinting, and a raised wet finger. A tanned, calm, honest face of twenty-six, smooth and brown, with dark eyes and fine lines at the corners from squinting, thin brows, a straight nose and a closed steady mouth. Hair: black, cropped, stiff with salt. Body: lean and balanced, riding the deck. Clothing: outer-gate dress of the Thúy Vi sect: a green-grey silk robe with two crossed collars and short wide sleeves exposing forearms tattooed with a small blue wave, a blue silk sailor's sash tied in a sheet-bend, silver wave embroidery on the borders, a small brass spyglass, dented at the end, at the belt. Hands and objects: one finger raised to the wind. Power: a faint pale blue wind-line of qi curls round the finger, a few motes riding it. Background: ship's rigging criss-crossing a pale glowing sky, a flag streaming out flat in the wind, the deck planks wet and bright. Light: bright silvery sea-light from the upper left, glinting on the gold rings, sun glittering on the sea behind him. Expression: calm and honest, brave, a steady, unhurried look of someone who trusts the wind to tell him the truth.

people.imagined: The slow oiler, blinking slowly as if the answer were far off, tung oil on the rag in his hands.
people.subject: The moment: oiling a pillar with a rag, he turns and blinks very slowly at the viewer as if the answer were far away. Face, most important: a slow, long blink, eyes half-closed, and a rag glistening amber with tung oil in his hand. A broad, placid, round face of twenty-nine, brown, with heavy-lidded eyes, thick brows, a snub nose, a mild mouth with the lips slightly parted, and a drop of oil shining on one cheek. Hair: black and short, bound with a green silk band. Body: big, slow and heavy. Clothing: outer-gate dress of the Thúy Vi sect: a green-grey silk robe with two crossed collars, the wide cuffs darkened and stiff with amber oil, a grey silk sash smudged with it, faint silver herb embroidery on the hem, a pot of tung oil with a brush at his feet. Hands and objects: the shiny oil rag in his hands. Power: a faint brown-green tint of qi glows in the oiled wood, motes of amber light floating. Background: a tall wooden hall pillar gleaming amber with fresh oil, a line of similar pillars receding into soft haze, a warm glow lying on the floor. Light: soft amber spirit-light from the upper left, bright on the wet wood, a thin pale rim on his cheek. Expression: patient and content, humble, a slow, mild, unhurried look as if the question had not quite reached him yet.

people.imagined: She waters old life trees with the steward, moss under her nails, carrying the news of a dead tree with him.
people.subject: The moment: kneeling at the root of an ancient pine in cold white mist, she presses a mossy hand to the bark, carrying the news of a dead tree with the steward. Face, most important: moss and dark soil under every nail, and an old tree trunk beside her face. A calm, pale, quiet face of about forty, with steady grey eyes, thin brows with lines of worry between them, a small nose and a closed gentle mouth with pale lips. Hair: black with a streak of grey, in a bun held with a jade hairpin and a pine twig. Body: slender and still. Clothing: the dry undyed pale silk of the Cliff Hall, a Foundation-Establishment disciple's finer cut: layered robes with three crossed collars edged in soft green, wide sleeves rolled and the knees damp from kneeling, a green silk over-apron with a pocket of moss, a jade herb pendant at the sash, silver mist and herb embroidery on the borders, a small copper watering ladle at her belt. Hands and objects: moss-stained hands pressed to the bark, a green smear of moss running to the wrist. Power: a gentle green aura of wood qi, thin mist and motes rising from the roots toward her palm. Background: an ancient pine with a twisted trunk rising into mist, small saplings with tiny tags dotting the slope. Light: soft silver mist-light from the upper left, giving the bark a silver edge and her cheek a pale green rim. Expression: a still, inward, quiet face with lowered eyes and a tight, held-back grief at the lips.

people.imagined: The Cliff Hall fighter with a bent nose from a fall on the cliff path, sworn brother of another, grinning cruelly.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a narrow cliff path above cloud, he grins with sharp eyes, hands loose at his sides, weight on the back foot as though ready to shove; he is sworn brother of another Cliff Hall fighter. Face, most important: a nose bent hard to the left from an old break, plainly crooked and purple at the bridge, and a mocking grin. A hard, wind-burnt face of thirty-six, brown, with narrow glinting dark eyes, thick brows, a lopsided smile and a thin scar crossing the lip. Hair: black, tied back in a topknot with a dark iron-grey pin, tousled. Body: lean, strong and loose-limbed, one knee slightly bent. Clothing: the dry undyed pale silk of the Cliff Hall in a fighter's cut: layered robe with two crossed collars edged in grey-green, short wide sleeves showing scarred forearms, a broad dark silk sash with a plain silver clasp, tight-laced silk-and-leather bracers; a jade herb pendant on the sash, thin silver mist embroidery on the borders. Hands: loose, one fist half clenched, the knuckles split. Power: a faint grey-green sheen of qi runs along the bracers, a few cold motes at his fists. Background: the cliff path dropping away to a sea of cloud, a rope handrail sagging between stakes, wet rock in drifting mist. Light: cold silver-grey spirit-light from the upper left, leaving the broken bridge of his nose in shadow and a pale gleam along the bracers. Expression: cruel and brave, loyal, a sharp, lopsided grin with no warmth in the eyes.

people.imagined: Forest-born, she chose the ridge over the slope; her wild fringe, trimmed with a kitchen knife, falls over her stubborn eyes.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a grave on the ridge in pale mist, she looks up stubbornly through an uneven fringe she trimmed herself with a kitchen knife; forest-born, she chose the ridge over the slope. Face, most important: a wild uneven fringe, cut with a kitchen knife, jagged across her forehead, and a stubborn gaze under it. A strong, plain, freckled face of thirty-two, olive, with dark, steady, defiant eyes, heavy brows, a straight nose and a firm mouth with the lip bitten. Hair: black, thick and long, with the jagged fringe, held at the back with a plain jade pin. Body: sturdy and upright. Clothing: the dry undyed pale silk of the Cliff Hall, a Foundation-Establishment disciple's cut: layered robes with two crossed collars edged in soft green, wide sleeves rolled, a green silk over-apron stained with sap, a jade herb pendant at the sash, thin silver herb embroidery on the borders, a kitchen knife in a sheath at her belt. Hands and objects: earthy hands holding a small bunch of wild herbs, small white flowers and soft grey leaves picked this morning. Power: a faint green mist of wood qi rises from the herbs, a few motes drifting upward. Background: an old stone grave with a leaning pine, a grey blanket of mist, a few wild herbs growing in the cracks of the stone. Light: pale silver spirit-light from the upper left, making her freckles stand out, a faint green rim. Expression: stubborn and devout, honest, a plain, unflinching look that does not ask to be liked.

people.imagined: The gatekeeper of eighty years walks without a sound on loud gravel, propping a sideways pine with a cedar brace.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a gate beside a leaning pine propped by cedar braces, looking calmly aside; the gatekeeper of eighty years walks without a sound on loud gravel. Face, most important: a sideways-leaning old pine propped with pale cedar braces beside him, and a calm, silent face. A lean, long, still face of about fifty-five, dark, silent as stone, with deep-set dark steady eyes, thick grey brows hanging low, a long nose and a closed mouth. Hair: grey, tied in a plain topknot with a jade pin. Body: tall, spare and quiet. Clothing: the dry undyed pale silk of the Cliff Hall, a Foundation-Establishment disciple's cut, neatly kept: layered robes with three crossed collars edged in grey-green, wide sleeves, a silk rope belt tied with a sailor's knot, a jade herb pendant, thin silver mist embroidery on the borders, felt-soled slippers so that he makes no sound, a bundle of cedar wedges at his hip. Hands and objects: one hand resting on a cedar brace. Power: a faint green-grey aura of wood qi lies about him as still as the mist, small motes among the pine needles. Background: a stone gate with a worn threshold, the sideways pine propped by pale cedar braces, low mist among the roots. Light: pale silver moonlight from the upper left with a faint green rim. Expression: reclusive and patient, loyal, a silent, unmoving composure, the face of a man who has watched the gate for eighty years and has never needed to speak.

people.imagined: Oldest of the Cliff Hall inner disciples, squinting at the sky for rain before every sentence.
people.subject: The moment: standing in the open on a bare ridge, he squints up at the sky for rain before answering, as he does before every sentence. Face, most important: eyes narrowed in a deep squint at the sky, and a lined brow. He appears about sixty-five, with a brown, deeply weathered face whose lines run like cracks, small pale eyes narrowed to slits, thick white brows bristling, a big nose and a tight mouth. Hair: white, tied in a hard knot with a plain jade pin. Body: tall, spare and bent. Clothing: the dry undyed pale silk of the Cliff Hall, the oldest inner disciple's richest dress, faded soft by washing and mended neatly at the elbows: three layered crossed collars edged in deep green, wide sleeves, a bony wrist showing, a silk rope sash knotted at the front with a jade herb pendant, silver mist embroidery on the borders, a woven straw rain cape over one shoulder lifted by the cold wind. Hands and objects: one hand raised palm up to feel for rain. Power: a faint grey-green aura of wood qi hangs about him like a weather-front, thin motes of light on the wind. Background: a pale heavy sky pressing on a bare ridge, a few dark pines against it, drifting mist. Light: pale silver cloud-light from the upper left with a faint cold rim. Expression: stubborn and just, callous, the set, weathered look of the oldest of the Cliff Hall inner disciples, who judges every sky and every person with the same long squint.
